findings.highlight: Caster is also resting on her laurels.
findings.governingReading: 手緩い says she is insufficiently ruthless: Archer immediately proposes taking lives rather than only magical energy.
findings.explanation: Caster being too lenient becomes resting on her laurels.

findings.highlight: I feel a chilling premonition of death.
findings.evidenceJa: 氷のような殺気が、真後ろから放たれた
findings.governingReading: Ice-cold killing intent is released directly behind Shirou, precipitating his response to Archer’s sword.
findings.explanation: Emitted murderous hostility from behind becomes a death premonition.

findings.highlight: He cuts me at the shoulder.
findings.evidenceJa: 肩口から袈裟に斬られた感触
findings.governingReading: 袈裟 describes a diagonal cut from the shoulder across the body; the later stroke repeats that trajectory.
findings.explanation: The repeated diagonal cut loses its trajectory.

findings.highlight: The pain so sharp that I feel
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みはあまりに鋭利で
findings.governingReading: The narrator says the pain is so sharp that skin and flesh seem burned.
findings.explanation: The pain description loses its finite verb.

findings.evidenceJa: 逃げよう、としての事じゃない
findings.governingReading: He explicitly says the initial retreat is not an attempt to flee: his powerless legs move backward only to prevent collapse. Conscious flight begins two pages later.
findings.explanation: Not yet trying to escape becomes inability to escape.

findings.highlight: he kills when he can ensure it.
findings.evidenceJa: 必殺の心構えで手を下す
findings.governingReading: 必殺の心構え is the determination to kill when striking, recalled to explain why Archer will not let his intended victim leave alive.
findings.explanation: The recalled resolve to finish a kill becomes killing only when able to ensure it.

findings.evidenceJa: もはや速いだの鋭いだのといった次元の問題ではなかった
findings.governingReading: The narrator says the technique is no longer a matter of being fast or sharp at his modest level of understanding.
findings.explanation: Beyond speed and sharpness becomes too swift and deadly.

findings.highlight: I have been complaining a lot.
findings.evidenceJa: 子供っぽかったな、と反省する
findings.governingReading: Prompted by Saber, Shirou reproaches himself for the childishness of his grumbling.
findings.explanation: Shirou still acknowledges his complaining, but his specific judgment that it was childish becomes a remark about how much he complained.

findings.governingReading: Saber announces one question then asks about betrayal.
findings.explanation: Two sentences run together without spacing.

findings.evidenceJa: シロウは不思議ですね
findings.governingReading: 不思議 says his no-promise/no-betrayal logic is puzzling or peculiar; the following fondness is Shirou’s perception.
findings.explanation: Saber’s finding Shirou strange becomes finding him a handful.

findings.evidenceJa: ぐっ、とセイバーの手を握って
findings.governingReading: Shirou grips her hand firmly and meets her eyes as he requests instruction in fighting.
findings.explanation: A firm grasp of Saber’s hand becomes a handshake.
